generic_domain.justification: Software quality encompasses a broad range of aspects related to software systems, including the evaluation and improvement of their overall effectiveness. Within this domain falls software quality analysis, which focuses on understanding and enhancing various quality attributes such as functionality, performance, usability, reliability, maintainability, and portability. Additionally, app quality is a subset focused specifically on applications (apps), which fall under the broader umbrella of software systems. Thus, 'software quality' serves as the most comprehensive domain as it covers all aspects related to ensuring that software meets specified requirements and user expectations.
